hypothesis: The existing read-only 500 Hz PhysicsEvidenceConsumer boundary can capture a bounded receiver-contact window with ball/root/joint state and attributed foot force without altering the six-G1 trajectory. This enables contact-normal and support diagnosis before any new time-dependent learner.

observer.trigger: first receiver foot contact after immediately previous measured ball horizontal speed >=0.30 m/s

noninterference_gate: For each scene, all stored 50 Hz ball pose/velocity, receiver joint position/velocity and ball-contact identity arrays must be bitwise identical to the corresponding v103 candidate 04 episode under the same thread settings; all six G1 safety results must also agree.
capture_gate: 75 preceding and 250 following consecutive 500 Hz records around a measured dynamic own-foot contact, with complete contact attribution, valid force/normal fields and no observer fault. No actor or motor proposal from observer.
interpretation: This is observational data for a future time-dependent contact/control learner, not a successful policy or permission to promote the v95 teacher.
